title: Answer with a line, not a crash
hints: `check` raises `Rejected` for a bad program. Right now nothing catches it, so `judge` crashes and returns no line at all.
Wrap the call in `try:` and add `except Rejected:` below it. Name the class, so that any other exception still crashes loudly.
Inside the `except Rejected:` block, `return "REJECTED " + path`. The `MATCH` line stays as the last line of the function.
explain: The reference puts `check(text)` inside `try:` and returns `"REJECTED " + path` from `except Rejected:`. It catches only its own exception class. A bug such as a `KeyError` still shows a traceback, which is what you want while you are building.
